name: BIOAQUA Facial Retinol Serum 30ml Anti-Wrinkle Tender Skin 8.5% Retinol 5% Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizing Essence
description:
BIOAQUA Facial Retinol Serum – 30ml
Brand: BIOAQUA | Origin: Made in China | Skin Type: All skin types

Key Benefits:

Anti-Wrinkle & Skin Firming: Contains 8.5% Retinol and 5% Hyaluronic Acid to help activate skin cells, firm, and plump the skin.

Even Skin Tone: Rejuvenates skin and improves elasticity, leaving a clear, even, and energized complexion.

Deep Hydration: Moisturizes and nourishes the skin with effective hydrating ingredients for a soft, supple feel.

Easy to Apply: Cleanse your face and apply a few drops, massaging gently for fast absorption. Suitable for morning and night use.

Versatile Use: Ideal for dry, oily, or combination skin; supports overall skin repair and revitalization.
